card.name: Start of tri- words, and stray spots
card.fires_on: Fires on the "tr" piece that begins tri- words such as triphosphate, triglycerides and Trisogel. Also fires on a lone "2" in a section reference and on "the" after "increase in".

modes.label: tri- word starts
modes.description: The "tr" piece that opens a word beginning with tri-, in drug or lab terms.

modes.label: Section number digit
modes.description: A digit inside a bracketed section cross-reference after a dosing sentence.

modes.label: The after increase in
modes.description: The word "the" right after "an increase in" before an age group.
modes.example: a tendency toward an increase in<< the>> younger patients

card.plain: It lights up on the opening of words like triglycerides and triphosphate, plus a couple of unrelated spots.
evidence: a tendency toward an increase in<< the>> younger patients for almost all drugs studied.
